result.title: Meet the Winners of the 2024 Goodreads Choice Awards
result.content: The 16th Annual Goodreads Choice Awards are now official! With a new record of more than 6.2 million votes cast, the 2024 awards continue the Goodreads tradition of honoring readers' favorite books of the year. This time around, we've got 15 separate categories with 300 nominated books total.

result.content: Alison Espach (born September 26, 1984) is an American novelist. Espach is the author of three novels —The Adults (2011), Notes on Your Sudden Disappearance (2022), and The Wedding People (2024).

The Wedding People will be published in over twenty countries. She is also the author of Notes on Your Sudden Disappearance, a Chicago Tribune and NPR "Best ...

result.title: Alison Espach - Wikiwand
result.content: Alison Espach is an American novelist. Espach is the author of three novels—The Adults (2011), Notes on Your Sudden Disappearance (2022), and The Wedding People (2024). She is a professor of English at Providence College in Rhode Island.

result.title: 艾莉森·埃斯帕赫 Alison Espach - 豆瓣
result.content: Alison Espach is the author of the novels The Wedding People, Notes on Your Sudden Disappearance, an Indie Next Pick and Amazon Editors' Pick for 2022, and The Adults, a New York Times Editor's Choice and Barnes and Noble Discover pick. She has written for McSweeney's, Vogue, Outside Magazine, Joyland and other places. She teaches creative writing at Providence College in Rhode Island.

result.title: Alison Espach (Author of The Wedding People) - Goodreads
result.content: Alison Espach grew up in Trumbull, Connecticut, where she lived for most of her life. She earned her BA from Providence College and her Masters in Creative Writing from Washington University in St. Louis. Her writing has appeared in McSweeney's, Five Chapters, Glamour, Salon, The Daily Beast, Writer's Digest, and other journals.

result.content: Candlewood Lake is a manmade lake located in Fairfield and Litchfield counties of Western Connecticut, in the northeastern United States. At 8.4 square miles (22 km2), it is the largest lake in Connecticut and the largest lake in the New York metropolitan area. [2]

#  Connecticut’s Great Lakes
last updated: March 2026 
Connecticut’s coastline isn’t our only waterfront claim to fame. Across the state, there are over 3,000 beautiful lakes, ponds and reservoirs that offer all kinds of water activities. See where you can take a swim, go out on the boat, fish, kayak, picnic, hike, camp and so much more. And don't miss all the great restaurants, hotels and B&Bs nearby.

##  Where to Make a Big Splash 
Some of the most popular lakes in Connecticut are also the most scenic. You’ll find sprawling freshwater lakes and beautiful vistas all over the state.
